title: 29.x: PO matching API, E-Documents integration and receipt-on-invoice line tracking
summary: Purchase order matching and receipt-on-invoice line tracking capabilities are added to E-Documents integration. New fields and APIs support matching purchase orders with incoming documents and tracking which receipt lines were invoiced.
key_points: New PO matching warning enum for E-Documents processing
Receipt-on-invoice policy enum and line tracking fields added to Purchase Line
E-Doc PO matching codeunit enhanced with new API functionality
Vendor and Purchase document schema updates across all localization layers
Upgrade scripts added for data migration and schema changes
